summary_ko: 그랑프리 참가 허용 대수가 30대에서 34대로, 결승 출전 대수가 24대에서 26대로 늘었다.
quote: The new rules for the 1982 season included an increase in the number of cars permitted to enter a Grand Prix from 30 to 34, and the number of starters from 24 to 26.

summary_ko: 예선에서 쓸 수 있는 타이어가 처음으로 세션당 두 세트로 제한됐다.
quote: For the first time the number of tyres permitted for qualification was limited to two sets per session

summary_ko: 스커트 사용이 한시적으로 다시 허용됐다.
quote: a new requirement that mandated F1 cars have flat bottoms between the inside tangent of the tyres (pictured above) and no skirts (which had gained a temporary reprieve in 1982)

summary_ko: 차량 최저 중량이 585kg에서 580kg으로 낮아졌다.
quote: In other regulation changes, the minimum weight of the cars was reduced from 585 kg (1,290 lb) to 580 kg (1,280 lb).

summary_ko: 경기 후 차량 중량을 경기를 마친 상태 그대로 측정하도록 결정됐다.
quote: It was further decided that the cars would now be weighed after the race in the condition in which they had finished

summary_ko: 양쪽 타이어 안쪽 접선 사이의 차체 바닥을 평평하게 만들도록 의무화되고 스커트가 금지돼 기존 방식의 그라운드 이펙트 설계를 쓸 수 없게 됐다.
quote: In fact it wasn't until 1983, after a campaign blighted by a number of serious accidents, that ground effect technology as designers knew it was stopped in its tracks by a new requirement that mandated F1 cars have flat bottoms between the inside tangent of the tyres (pictured above) and no skirts

summary_ko: 사륜구동 차량과 바퀴가 네 개를 넘는 차량이 금지됐다.
quote: Ground effect undertrays outlawed completely for the beginning of the 1983 season; all cars return to a flat undertray. Four-wheel drive banned, along with cars with more than four wheels, minimum weight reduced to 540 kg (1,190 lb)

summary_ko: 차량 최저 중량이 540kg으로 낮아졌다.
quote: Ground effect undertrays outlawed completely for the beginning of the 1983 season; all cars return to a flat undertray. Four-wheel drive banned, along with cars with more than four wheels, minimum weight reduced to 540 kg (1,190 lb)

summary_ko: 경기 중 재급유가 금지됐다.
quote: Fuel stops were not permitted, having been banned from 1984.

summary_ko: 최대 연료 허용량이 220리터로 제한됐다.
quote: Since '84 there had been a maximum fuel limit of 220 litres

summary_ko: 리어 윙의 폭이 좁아졌다.
quote: The rear wings became narrower to produce less aerodynamic drag

summary_ko: 터보차저 엔진 사용이 의무화돼 자연흡기 엔진을 쓸 수 없게 됐다.
quote: So after mandating turbocharged engines for 1986, the governing body decided to re-allow naturally aspirated engines for 1987

summary_ko: 최대 연료 허용량이 220리터에서 195리터로 줄었다.
quote: Since '84 there had been a maximum fuel limit of 220 litres – and for '86 this was reduced to 195 litres, ahead of boost limits in the following two seasons.

summary_ko: 자연흡기 엔진 차량의 드라이버와 컨스트럭터를 대상으로 한 짐 클라크 트로피와 콜린 채프먼 트로피가 함께 열렸다.
quote: The season also encompassed the Jim Clark Trophy and the Colin Chapman Trophy, which were respectively contested by drivers and constructors of Formula One cars powered by naturally aspirated engines.

summary_ko: 터보 엔진의 부스트 압력이 4바로 제한됐다.
quote: hugely powerful RA167E, which got around the 4-bar turbo boost limit regulated for ’87 to be even more powerful than the unrestricted ’86 engine.

summary_ko: 자연흡기 엔진의 최대 배기량이 3.5리터로 정해졌다.
quote: Naturally aspirated engines could now have a maximum displacement of 3.5 litres, up from 3.0.

summary_ko: 예비 예선(프리 퀄리파잉)이 다시 도입되어 다섯 대가 금요일 오전에 별도 세션을 치렀다.
quote: So pre-qualifying, which had been used in several races during the late 1970s and early 1980s, was re-introduced. For 1988, this consisted of five cars taking part in an extra session on Friday morning

summary_ko: 터보 엔진의 부스트 압력 한도가 4바에서 2.5바로, 연료 허용량이 195리터에서 150리터로 줄었다.
quote: in the last season of the 1.5-litre turbo formula, when significant rule changes limited both horsepower and fuel allowance, Ferrari lost ground again. From 4-bar boost and 195 litres of fuel, the turbocharged cars were now limited to 2.5 bar and 150 litres.

summary_ko: 드라이버의 발을 앞 차축선 뒤에 두는 규정이 도입되어 신규 섀시에 의무화됐다.
quote: the driver's feet must be situated behind the front axle-line. This rule had been introduced in 1988 and was mandatory for all new chassis

summary_ko: 서바이벌 셀과 연료 탱크가 정적 충돌 테스트를 통과하도록 의무화됐다.
quote: The survival cell and fuel tank would now have to pass a static crash test.

summary_ko: 레이스 거리가 305km로 표준화됐다.
quote: Race distances were standardised at 305 km (190 mi) in order to keep the races within the two-hour time limit.

summary_ko: 예비 예선이 유지되면서 참가 대수가 13대로 늘었고, 가장 빠른 4대가 본 예선에 진출했다.
quote: So pre-qualifying was retained from 1988 and expanded to 13 cars. The four fastest cars would be allowed into the main qualifying session

summary_ko: 터보 엔진이 금지되고 3.5리터 자연흡기 엔진으로 전환됐다.
quote: But for 1989 turbo engines were outlawed and instead Honda had to produce a 3.5-litre naturally aspirated V10 engine.

summary_ko: 드라이버의 발을 앞 차축선 뒤에 두는 규정이 신규 섀시뿐 아니라 모든 차량에 의무화됐다.
quote: the driver's feet must be situated behind the front axle-line. This rule had been introduced in 1988 and was mandatory for all new chassis, but any that were a carry-over from 1987 were not obliged to comply with the rule which was only made compulsory for all cars from 1989.

summary_ko: 더 큰 후사경을 달도록 규정됐다.
quote: Larger rear-view mirrors

summary_ko: 탈착식 스티어링 휠이 의무화됐다.
quote: Quick-release steering wheel mandatory

summary_ko: 우승 점수가 9점에서 10점으로 늘었다.
quote: The winning driver was now awarded 10 points instead of 9 as previously.

summary_ko: 드라이버 챔피언십에서 상위 11개 결과만 합산하던 방식이 없어지고 모든 경기의 점수가 합산됐다.
quote: More significantly, points from all races would now count towards the drivers' championship, instead of only each driver's best eleven results as previously.

summary_ko: 프런트 윙 폭이 150cm에서 140cm로 줄었다.
quote: The front wing was narrowed from 150 cm (59 in) to 140 cm (55 in).

summary_ko: 리어 오버행이 60cm에서 50cm로 줄었다.
quote: The rear overhang was reduced from 60 cm (24 in) to 50 cm (20 in).

summary_ko: 드라이버를 제외한 최저 중량이 500kg에서 505kg으로 늘었다.
quote: The minimum weight (without driver) was raised from 500 kg (1,100 lb) to 505 kg (1,113 lb).

summary_ko: 건강 위험을 이유로 화학적 독성이 더 낮은 연료를 쓰도록 의무화됐다.
quote: Because of the health risk, the fuel was mandated to be less chemically toxic from 1992

summary_ko: 헝가리 그랑프리부터 FISA가 시판 연료만 쓰도록 했다.
quote: From the Hungarian Grand Prix, FISA mandated pump fuel only with lower octane, further reducing engine power.

summary_ko: 1992년 영국과 프랑스 그랑프리의 시범 운영을 거쳐 세이프티 카가 모든 그랑프리 주말에 공식 도입됐다.
quote: It was not until the 1993 season that Formula 1 officially introduced the Safety Car as a fixture at all race weekends, after trial runs at both the British and French Grands Prix in 1992.

summary_ko: 예선에서 드라이버마다 두 세션 모두 12랩까지만 달릴 수 있게 됐다.
quote: Each driver was limited to 12 laps in both qualifying sessions.

summary_ko: 차량 폭이 2,150mm에서 2,000mm로 줄었다.
quote: A reduction of the cars' track from 2,150 mm (7 ft 1 in) to 2,000 mm (6 ft 7 in)

summary_ko: 뒷타이어 폭이 18인치에서 15인치로 줄었다.
quote: A reduction in tyre width: the rears going from 18 in (457 mm) to 15 in (381 mm)

summary_ko: 시즌 중 피트 레인 속도 제한이 도입됐다.
quote: During the course of the 1994 season, one laced by tragedy, pit lane speed limits were introduced, and the exact speed has evolved across the following decades.

summary_ko: 트랙션 컨트롤, 액티브 서스펜션, ABS를 비롯한 전자 장치가 금지됐다.
quote: After dominating the previous two seasons, everyone expected Williams still to be the team to beat in 1994. But the ban on electronic ‘gizmos’, including traction control, active suspension and anti-lock brakes, hit Williams harder than expected.

summary_ko: 레이스 중 재급유가 1983년 이후 처음으로 허용됐다.
quote: All of the above devices were banned for the 1994 campaign, though, while in-race refuelling was permitted for the first time since 1983, forcing teams to go back to their drawing boards and try to find lap time elsewhere.

summary_ko: 시즌 중 스페인 그랑프리에서 디퓨저가 짧아지고 앞날개 엔드플레이트가 바뀌었으며, 캐나다 그랑프리에서는 엔진 출력을 낮추기 위해 에어박스에 구멍이 뚫렸다.
quote: We immediately [for the Spanish Grand Prix, race five] shortened the diffuser and changed the front wing endplates to reduce front wing downforce. Then we opened holes in the airbox to reduce engine power [Canadian Grand Prix, race six].

summary_ko: 독일 그랑프리부터 차량에 플랭크를 달게 되어 차고를 높여야 했다.
quote: A little bit later [German Grand Prix, race nine] we fitted the ‘plank’ to the car – this was a significant change because it meant the whole car had to be raised. Everything changed about how those 1994 cars had been designed to work.

summary_ko: 엔진 배기량이 3.5리터에서 3리터로 줄었다.
quote: This season was the last year of the 3.5 litre engine Formula One which had started 1989 following the ban on turbocharged engines at the end of 1988. For 1995 engine capacity would be reduced to 3 litres for safety reasons.

summary_ko: 차량 바닥에 스텝드 플랫 보텀이 도입됐다.
quote: This included, in 1995, the introduction of the stepped flat bottom, a measure which at the time slashed overall downforce levels by as much as 30 percent.

summary_ko: 차량에 충격 흡수 측면 구조가 의무화됐고 이 구조는 충돌 시험을 거쳐야 했다.
quote: Cars had to have impact absorbing side structures, which would have to undergo impact tests.

summary_ko: 최소 중량이 드라이버를 포함하는 기준으로 바뀌어 595kg이 됐다.
quote: The minimum weight of the cars was increased from 515 kilograms (1,135 lb) to 525 kilograms (1,157 lb) to account for the new safety measures, and then increased to 595 kilograms (1,312 lb) to include the driver.

summary_ko: 그리드를 드라이버당 최대 12랩이 주어지는 1시간짜리 단일 예선 세션으로 정하게 됐다.
quote: In order to ensure that every Saturday session had the potential to be a thriller, the rules were tweaked ahead of the 1996 season with the grid to be decided by a single one-hour session in which drivers had a maximum of 12 laps to set the best time they could.

summary_ko: 모든 차량이 폴 포지션 기록의 107% 이내에 들어야 결승에 나설 수 있는 107% 규정이 도입됐다.
quote: This year saw the introduction of the "107% rule", which meant all cars had to be within 107% of the pole position time in order to qualify for the race.

summary_ko: 출발 신호가 적색등과 녹색등 방식에서 적색등 다섯 개가 차례로 켜진 뒤 동시에 꺼지는 방식으로 바뀌었다.
quote: The previous system of having a red and green light to start the race was replaced by the current system of five red lights turning on sequentially with a period of usually five seconds, then all going out simultaneously before starting the race.

summary_ko: 전년도 드라이버 챔피언이 1번, 팀 동료가 2번을 받고 나머지 팀은 전년도 컨스트럭터 챔피언십 순위대로 번호를 받는 방식이 도입됐다.
quote: For 1996 the reigning Drivers' Champion was given number 1 and his teammate number 2 with the rest of the teams numbered in the order of their finishing position in the previous year's Constructors' Championship.

summary_ko: 드라이버 머리 보호를 위해 콕핏 측면이 높아지고 헤드레스트 패딩 강화가 의무화됐다.
quote: Regulation changes for 1996, inspired by accidents such as the one that left Karl Wendlinger in a coma at Monaco in ‘94, meant protection of the driver’s head was improved by the cockpit sides being raised and increased headrest padding being mandated.

summary_ko: 드라이버는 예선 전까지 두 가지 규격의 드라이 타이어를 쓸 수 있되, 예선이 시작되기 전에 남은 일정에서 쓸 한 가지 규격을 지정하도록 했다.
quote: Prior to the qualifying practice each driver may use two specifications of dry-weather tyres but must, before qualifying practice begins, nominate which specification of tyre he will use for the remainder of the Event.

summary_ko: 차량 전후방 충격 흡수 구조에 관한 기술이 더 구체화된 것 외에는 기술 규정이 바뀌지 않았다.
quote: Except for a more detailed description of the impact absorbing structures at the front and rear of the car, there were no changes for the 1997 season.

summary_ko: 홈이 앞 타이어에 3개, 뒤 타이어에 4개 파인 그루브 타이어가 도입됐다.
quote: The 1998 season signalled the start of a ‘narrow track’ era in F1, with car widths reduced from two metres to 1.8m, while grooved tyres were also introduced (three on the front, four on the rear) to get spiralling speeds under control.

summary_ko: 휠을 포함한 차량 전폭 상한이 200cm에서 180cm로 줄었다.
quote: The overall width of the car including complete wheels shall not exceed 180cm (previously 200cm) with the steered wheels in the straight ahead position (Article 3 of 1998 Technical Regulations).

summary_ko: 브레이크는 바퀴마다 캘리퍼 1개(피스톤 6개)와 디스크 1장으로 제한됐다.
quote: 11.2.2 - No more than 1 caliper, with 6 pistons, is permitted on each wheel. 11.2.3 - The section of each caliper piston must be circular. 11.3 Brake discs : 11.3.1 - No more than one brake disc is permitted on each wheel.

summary_ko: FIA 기술 부서는 4월 27일 일부 차량에 단 미드 윙렛이 위험하다고 팀들에 통보했으며, 이후 대회에서 이를 단 차량은 대회 심사위원에게 실격을 요청하기로 했다.
quote: F1 UPDATE 30-04-1998 On 27th April the teams were informed by the FIA Technical Department that the mid-winglets fitted on certain Formula One cars were considered dangerous. Should any car be fitted with such a device in future events, the Stewards of the Meeting will be invited to exclude it under Art.127 of the International Sporting Code and Art. 2.3 of the Formula One Technical Regulations ("Dangerous Construction").

summary_ko: 앞 타이어에 네 번째 홈이 추가돼 홈 수가 뒤 타이어와 같아졌다.
quote: the rulemakers also had the option of adding further grooves to control speeds, which they did in 1999, introducing a fourth groove to the front tyre so that it matched the rear.

summary_ko: 사고 때 바퀴가 떨어져 나가지 않도록 휠 테더가 도입됐다.
quote: 1999 – Wheel tethers Wheel tethers are introduced to ensure wheels do not break free in the event of an accident.

summary_ko: 피트 레인 제한 속도가 연습 주행에서는 시속 80km에서 60km로, 웜업과 결승에서는 시속 120km에서 80km로 낮아졌다.
quote: SPORTING REGULATIONS (1 January 2000): Safety – A speed limit of 60 km/h in practice (previously 80 km/h) and 80 km/h (previously 120 km/h) during the warm up and the race will be enforced in the pit lane except in Monaco, where the limit will be 60 km/h throughout the Event.

summary_ko: 선두가 2랩을 마친 뒤 레이스 거리의 75%를 채우기 전에 중단됐다가 재개되는 레이스에서 두 구간의 기록을 더 이상 합산하지 않게 됐다.
quote: Stopping and restarting a race - If a race is stopped and restarted after the leader has completed the second lap but before he has completed 75% of the total race distance (case B), the times for the two parts will no longer be aggregated.

summary_ko: 신규 참가 신청자는 신청할 때 FIA에 4,800만 달러를 예치하도록 했다.
quote: New applicants must deposit US$ 48,000,000 with the FIA when submitting an application.

summary_ko: 모든 엔진을 10기통으로 하도록 정해졌다.
quote: TECHNICAL REGULATIONS (1 January 2000): Engine specification – All engines will have 10 cylinders at least until the expiry of the current Concorde Agreement on 31 December 2007.

summary_ko: 2001년 1월 1일부터 시즌 마지막 그랑프리와 12월 31일 사이에는 모든 서킷에서 테스트가 금지됐다.
quote: Testing – As from 1 January 2001, testing will be prohibited on all circuits between the last Grand Prix and 31 December.

summary_ko: 팀 대표들의 합의에 따라 2001 시즌부터 8월 중 시즌 중 테스트가 금지됐다.
quote: Ten days later at the Monza Circuit, team bosses accepted to ban in-season testing during the month of August, from the 2001 season onwards.

summary_ko: 프론트 윙 높이가 50mm 높아졌다.
quote: Changes to the Formula One Technical Regulations for 2001, unanimously agreed by the competing teams and proposed by the Formula One Technical working group, were approved. The main changes and new provisions are the following : - front wing is 50mm higher;

summary_ko: 리어 윙은 상단부가 최대 3개, 하단부가 1개의 엘리먼트로 제한됐다.
quote: The upper section of the rear wing could now only consist out of a maximum of three elements, and the lower point out of just one element.

summary_ko: 트랙션 컨트롤, 론치 컨트롤, 완전 자동 변속기가 스페인 그랑프리부터 다시 도입됐다.
quote: The next round in Spain was the first after the reintroduction of traction control, launch control, and fully-automatic transmissions.

summary_ko: 알루미늄 베릴륨 합금처럼 비탄성률이 40 GPa/(g/cm3)를 넘는 소재가 엔진 부품을 포함해 전면 금지됐다.
quote: Materials - Materials which have a specific modulus of elasticity greater than 40 GPa/(g/cm3) (e.g. aluminium beryllium alloy) are banned with immediate effect, except for internal engine parts. A total ban, including engine parts, comes into force on 1 January 2001.

summary_ko: 트랙 위의 차량과 피트 사이에서 데이터를 양방향으로 주고받는 텔레메트리가 허용됐다.
quote: Data transfer between the car on track and the crew in the garage could now occur both ways.

summary_ko: 포인트를 받는 순위가 상위 6명에서 상위 8명으로 늘어났다.
quote: The F1 points system has gone through various changes across previous eras in the sport's 75 years of history; only the top five scored in the championship’s early years, for example, with this extending to the top six in 1960, which then became the first eight finishers in 2003.

summary_ko: 예선이 한 대씩 나와 1랩만 달리는 원랩 방식으로 바뀌어 금요일과 토요일에 한 차례씩 치러졌다.
quote: In 2003, one-lap qualifying replaced the previous format. On the Friday, drivers would emerge one at a time in championship order. The order of that session was reversed for another one-lap shootout on Saturday (to give Friday’s slowest driver a clean track and potential advantage).

summary_ko: 예선과 결승 사이에 차량에 연료를 넣거나 빼는 것이 금지됐다.
quote: On 26 February 2003, the FIA decided that no fuel could be added to or removed from the cars between qualifying and race

summary_ko: 드라이버의 HANS 장치 착용이 의무화됐다.
quote: After proven success in other championships – IndyCar’s Richie Hearn walked away from a 139G crash in Kentucky with just a broken foot – the FIA made HANS compulsory in 2003.

summary_ko: 양방향 텔레메트리가 금지됐다.
quote: Bi-directional telemetry banned

summary_ko: 엔진 하나로 레이스 주말 전체를 치르는 규정이 도입됐고, 주말 중 엔진을 교체하면 10그리드 강등 페널티를 받게 됐다.
quote: To reduce costs, a rule was introduced that each engine must last the entire race weekend. If an engine needs to be replaced during the weekend, the driver will be penalized by a ten-place grid penalty.

summary_ko: 두 차례의 원랩 예선 세션이 모두 토요일에 치러지게 됐고, 첫 세션의 주행 순서는 직전 대회 결과로 정해졌다.
quote: In a slight tweak from 2003, both one-lap sessions were held on Saturday from the start of the 2004 season, with the running order in the first session now determined by the classification at the previous race.

summary_ko: 전년도 컨스트럭터 챔피언십 4위 안에 들지 못한 팀은 금요일 연습 주행에서 테스트용 세 번째 차량을 운용할 수 있게 됐다.
quote: From the 2004 season onward, all the teams that did not finish in the top four in the previous year's Constructors' Championship were allowed to run a third car in the Friday practice session before each Grand Prix, for testing purposes.

summary_ko: 완전 자동 변속기와 론치 컨트롤이 금지됐다.
quote: The 2004 season also saw a change in technical regulations, including banning fully-automatic gearboxes and launch control

summary_ko: 레이스 중 타이어 교체가 금지됐다.
quote: although the engine technical regulations were unchanged in 2005, not much else was. New aerodynamic restrictions applied to the front and rear of the cars and a new sporting regulation – which lasted only for this season – stipulated no tyre changes during the race.

summary_ko: 엔진 하나로 두 번의 레이스 주말을 치러야 하게 됐다.
quote: In addition, there was a late-notice requirement that each engine should last not one weekend, as in 2004, but two.

summary_ko: 예선이 토요일 오후 저연료 1랩과 일요일 오전 레이스 연료 1랩의 기록을 합산해 그리드를 정하는 방식으로 바뀌었다.
quote: Unsurprisingly further tweaks followed, and in 2005 it was decided that the grid would be decided by aggregating the times from two single-lap qualifying runs - one on Saturday afternoon on low fuel and one on Sunday morning when the cars would have to be fuelled for the race.

summary_ko: 새 예선 방식은 시즌 첫 6개 대회에서 쓰였다.
quote: The first six races of the 2005 season used a new qualifying format

summary_ko: 프런트 윙 바깥쪽 부분이 50mm 높아지고 디퓨저 바깥쪽 채널에 최대 높이가 새로 정해졌다.
quote: The new aero regulations for 2005 stipulated that the outboard area of the front wing be raised by 50mm, taking it out of ground effect and therefore making it less effective. At the rear, the outer channels of the diffuser had a newly-defined maximum height.

summary_ko: 예선이 세 구간으로 나뉘어 구간마다 가장 느린 드라이버들이 탈락하고 남은 10명이 폴 포지션을 다투는 방식으로 바뀌었다.
quote: F1 went back to its roots with multi-lap qualifying in 2006, albeit with an exciting new twist. A new three-part qualifying system was drawn up, with the slowest drivers being progressively eliminated from each segment until 10 are left to fight it out for pole position.

summary_ko: 레이스 중 타이어 교체가 다시 허용됐다.
quote: Tyre changes returned to Formula One in 2006.

summary_ko: 엔진 규격이 2.4리터 V8로 바뀌었고, 토로 로소는 동등성 규정에 따라 회전수와 흡기를 제한한 3.0리터 V10을 계속 썼다.
quote: Formula One racing switched to a 2.4-litre V8 engine Formula in 2006, though controversial equivalency rules allowed Toro Rosso to continue to run a 3.0-litre V10 Cosworth during their inaugural season, albeit with significant rev and air intake restrictions.

summary_ko: 르노가 쓰던 매스 댐퍼 시스템이 기술 규정에 맞지 않는다는 FIA 결정에 따라 시즌 중 금지됐다.
quote: The FIA decided that the 'Mass Damper' system used by Renault up to this point of the season did not meet the technical regulations, and it was banned

summary_ko: 엔진 개발이 2006년 일본 그랑프리 시점을 기준으로 동결됐고, 이 엔진을 2007 시즌 내내 쓰게 됐다.
quote: Engine development was frozen from the 2006 Japanese Grand Prix, with these engines being used for the whole of 2007 and 2008.

summary_ko: 레이스 중 하드와 소프트 두 가지 타이어 컴파운드를 모두 한 번 이상 써야 하게 됐다.
quote: During the race both compounds of tyre (hard and soft) had to be used at least once.

summary_ko: 세이프티 카 상황에서는 모든 차량이 세이프티 카 뒤에 모이고 피트 레인 개방이 통보될 때까지 급유를 위한 피트 진입이 금지됐다.
quote: No car was allowed to enter the pits to refuel during a safety car period until all cars were in the group following the safety car and they were advised that the pit lane was open.

summary_ko: 전년도 컨스트럭터 챔피언십 5위부터 11위 팀에 허용되던 금요일 세 번째 차량 운용이 금지됐다.
quote: The teams finishing 5th–11th in the previous season's Constructors' Championship were no longer allowed to run a third car on Friday following a rule change

summary_ko: 엔진 회전수가 19,000rpm으로 제한됐다.
quote: rev limit of 19,000 rpm introduced
